Step 4, task 2: superpose the marched size classes, mass-weighted, and score the ensemble.

certification: TEMPORARILY_UNCERTIFIED_EMERGENCY_2026-09-30.  fitted: false.

Each class k (evidence/step4/classes.json) was marched as a single particle from the ladder's X0 = 0.19953 with
the front at 0.999 R (runs/step4/<name>.steps.jsonl).  On the sample clock (t = 0 at the first digitized sample,
X = x0_sample) the class's curve is
  X_k(t) = x0_sample - r_k t                       for t < o_k = (x0_sample - X0) / r_k  (closed form, the
                                                   class's film-limited constant rate; derived, not marched)
  X_k(t) = X_march,k(t - o_k)                      while the march has committed strides,
  after the march's last committed stride:
    stop at the centre cell (core end; typed refusal "accepted-history routing needs one interior cut face"):
      the core's remaining mobile liquid is removed at the march's own rate over its last 20 strides (step 3's
      derived core end), then the class holds the loading at its core end (the sorbed tail is not marched;
      the Crank variant below is derived);
    any other stop (a refusal before the core end): the class is not covered past its last committed stride,
      and the ensemble's coverage ends there.
The ensemble is X(t) = sum_k w_k X_k(t) (w_k the class mass weights, sum 1).  Mean particle temperature: the
mass-weighted mean of the classes' volume-weighted mean temperatures (T_b before a class's march starts,
the constant-rate period at the boiling plateau; the last marched value after its end, flagged).
Readings: the time from the ensemble's crossing of 0.20 to 0.10, and its ratio to the measured 25.35 / 42.50 s;
the scorer (scorer/score_march_vs_faner.py, --format generic --time-origin zero) on the sample clock and on the
crossing-matched clock; the boiling mass fraction; the plateau by the mass-weighted mean temperature.
usage (PYTHONPATH export/src): python step4/superpose.py FAMILY CELLS TAG [CLASS=RUNNAME ...]
